program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_m":  (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # bottom mirror devices M1/M2
    "L_m":     (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),
    "gmid_c":  (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # cascode devices M3/M4
    "L_c":     (0.8, 0.3, 2.0),
    "vds1":    (0.13, 0.08, 0.25),     # target drain voltage of M1/M2
    "rtrim":   (1.0, 0.7, 1.4),        # trim factor on computed R
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vds1 = p["vds1"]
    # bottom mirror pair (identical, ratio 1)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], I, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], I, vds=vds1)
    # reference-side cascode M3: drain at g1 (= Vgs1), source at vds1 (body effect)
    vds3 = max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.1)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=vds3, vsb=vds1)
    # output cascode M4: drain at nominal output voltage
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=vout - vds1, vsb=vds1)
    # bias resistor: Vg_cascode = Vgs1 + I*R = vds1 + Vgs3
    dv = max(m3.vgs + vds1 - m1.vgs, 0.02)
    R = p["rtrim"] * dv / I

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.R("RB", "iin", "g1", R)
    n.dev("M3", "g1", "iin", "x1", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "g1", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "g1", "vss", "vss", m2)

    # predictions
    rout = (m4.gm + m4.gmbs + m4.gds) / (m4.gds * m2.gds) + 1.0 / m2.gds
    # residual error: Vds mismatch of M2 vs M1 attenuated by cascode loop gain
    dvx = (vout - vds3) * m4.gds / (m4.gm + m4.gmbs)
    err = 100.0 * abs(dvx) * m2.gds / I + 0.2
    vcomp = vds1 + 0.8 * m4.vdsat
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp,
               "power": 2 * I * 1.8}
